infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Voxt records your voice while you use its shortcut or during a meeting you start, and recognises it on this Mac, or with the speech service you set up. 录音在你使用快捷键时，或在你开始的会议中进行，在这台 Mac 上识别，或交给你设置的语音服务识别。
infoPlist.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Voxt records the sound other apps play during a meeting you start, and recognises it on this Mac, or with the speech service you chose for meetings. 会议时 Voxt 录下其他 app 播放的声音，在这台 Mac 上识别，或交给你为会议选的语音服务。
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: System dictation recognises your voice with macOS's own speech recognition, on this Mac: the audio never leaves it. 系统听写用 macOS 自带的语音识别在这台 Mac 上识别你的声音：音频不会离开这台 Mac。
